description: 800 mA ultralow-noise, high-PSRR fixed-output RF LDO linear regulator. It runs from 4.5 V to 16 V and gives 1.0 µV rms noise (100 Hz to 100 kHz) and more than 90 dB PSRR from 1 kHz to 100 kHz. Fixed output options are 1.8, 2.8, 3.0, 3.3, 4.5, 4.8 and 5.0 V.

groups.description: Input supply (VIN), regulated output (VOUT), and the internal VREG, REF and BYP nodes. Each of these pins needs its own ceramic bypass capacitor to GND: 10 µF on VIN, VOUT and VREG, and 1 µF on REF and BYP.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: The GND pin and the exposed thermal pad, which is tied to GND internally. Both should go to a solid ground plane for electrical and thermal performance.
groups.name: GROUND

groups.description: The EN logic input turns the regulator on and off. REF_SENSE must be shorted to REF on fixed-output versions.
groups.name: CONTROL

pins.description: Regulated input supply to the LDO amplifier. Bypass VREG to GND with a 10 µF or larger capacitor (at least 7 µF effective). Do not connect a load to ground.
pins.name: VREG

pins.description: Regulated output voltage, up to 800 mA. Bypass VOUT to GND with a 10 µF or larger ceramic capacitor (at least 7 µF effective, ESR 0.001 to 0.2 Ω).
pins.name: VOUT

pins.description: Low-noise bypass capacitor pin. Connect a 1 µF capacitor (0.1 µF minimum) to GND to reduce noise. Do not connect a load to ground.
pins.name: BYP

pins.description: Reference sense input. It must be connected to the REF pin for proper operation (short to REF for fixed output voltages). Do not connect to VOUT or GND.
pins.name: REF_SENSE

pins.description: Low-noise reference voltage output. Bypass REF to GND with a 1 µF capacitor (0.7 µF minimum) and short REF_SENSE to REF for fixed output voltages. Do not connect a load to ground.
pins.name: REF

pins.description: Enable input. Drive high (3.2 V or more) to turn the regulator on and low (0.8 V or less) to turn it off. Tie EN to VIN for automatic startup. Tolerates up to 18 V.
pins.name: EN

pins.description: Regulator input supply, 4.5 V to 16 V (abs max 18 V). Bypass VIN to GND with a 10 µF or larger capacitor.
pins.name: VIN

pins.description: Exposed pad on the bottom of the package. It is electrically connected to GND inside the package and improves thermal performance. Connect it to the board ground plane.
pins.name: EPAD

variants.notes: 8 leads plus an exposed pad (EP about 3.1 x 2.41 mm) tied to GND. Output voltage is set by the ordering suffix.
Same pin assignment. Exposed pad is about 2.34 x 1.60 mm and tied to GND.
